# try.clavastack.com

> Browser-based interactive simulators for the Specter DIY hardware wallet family, hosted by ClavaStack.

## What is this site?

try.clavastack.com runs tested Specter firmware builds locally in the visitor's
browser using WebAssembly. No wallet data, seed material, QR contents, virtual
SD-card contents, or webcam frames are uploaded by the browser simulator.

Use test seed phrases only. A browser simulation does not provide the physical
security properties of a hardware wallet.

## Available simulators

- Specter DIY: https://try.clavastack.com/
- Multi-device gallery: https://try.clavastack.com/simulators/

## Source

- Site and deployment: https://github.com/schnuartz-ai/try-clavastack
- Specter DIY: https://github.com/cryptoadvance/specter-diy
- Specter Playground: https://github.com/k9ert/specter-playground
- ClavaStack Playground variant: https://github.com/schnuartz-ai/specter-playground-schnuartz

## About ClavaStack

ClavaStack sells pre-assembled Specter DIY hardware wallets.

- Website: https://clavastack.com/
- Firmware verification: https://verify.clavastack.com/
